name: Can I make changes to my project plan after permits have been approved?

mainEntity.name: Can I make changes to my project plan after permits have been approved?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor adjustments may sometimes be accommodated, significant changes to your project plan after permit approval typically require a permit revision, which can add time and cost to your renovation. For instance, if you decide to substantially alter the footprint of an addition or relocate a major plumbing stack in a luxury bathroom, amended plans must often be resubmitted and re-approved by the city. AKN Design Group works diligently during the design phase to finalize plans and minimize such revisions, emphasizing clear communication and detailed planning to ensure a seamless homeowner experience and avoid unnecessary delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Significant project changes after permit approval usually require a permit revision, adding time and cost. AKN Design Group minimizes this through detailed upfront planning.
